نستشرق (form X)
# نَسْتَشْرِقُ (nastašriqu) /nas.taʃ.ri.qu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِسْتَشْرَقَ (istašraqa)
# نَسْتَشْرِقَ (nastašriqa) /nas.taʃ.ri.qa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِسْتَشْرَقَ (istašraqa)
# نَسْتَشْرِقْ (nastašriq) /nas.taʃ.riq/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِسْتَشْرَقَ (istašraqa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
